args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're so pleased to have you joining our team next week in the marketing department.

We wanted to make sure you feel welcomed and comfortable from day one, so please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions about the role, our team, or the onboarding process. We're here to help you settle in and do your best work.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
